content.text: No exclusivity binds Sanofi anywhere in the agreement. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: Licenses. Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, RevMed hereby grants to Sanofi an exclusive (even as to RevMed and its Affiliates), royalty-bearing license (which shall be sub-licensable solely as provided in Section 3.4) under the RevMed Licensed Technology, to Research, Develop, Manufacture, use, sell, offer for sale, import and otherwise Commercialize and exploit Products (including, for clarity, any Companion Diagnostics with respect to such Products) in the Field in the Licensed Territory.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Sanofi, so it meets the preferred position. Every exclusivity mechanic runs in our favour or against RevMed: Section 3.1 grants Sanofi an exclusive licence even as to RevMed and its Affiliates (p0248); Section 3.5(a) restrains RevMed (not Sanofi) from working on SHP2 Inhibitor products outside the Collaboration (p0261); and Section 13.2(q) is a RevMed representation that no third-party exclusivity provisions limit Sanofi's rights (p0560). On sourcing, Section 7.2(c) expressly requires RevMed to support Sanofi in establishing its own supply agreements with third-party suppliers (p0359), and Section 7.3 supply arrangements are only to be negotiated where a Party elects to Manufacture for the other, with no requirements commitment by Sanofi. Two adjacent mechanics were considered and are out of scope: (i) Section 12.2(d) gives RevMed a termination right if Sanofi develops a Competing Product (p0493) — a termination consequence assessed under the termination rules, not a covenant prohibiting Sanofi from using or developing alternatives; and (ii) the SHP1-SHP2 Dual Inhibitor exclusive-negotiation window in Section 3.5(b) (p0263) is a first-negotiation mechanic that benefits Sanofi and bars RevMed, not Sanofi, from third-party dealings. No redline is warranted.

mappings.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.
mappings.quote: Except pursuant to or as expressly permitted by this Agreement, RevMed shall not, shall cause its Affiliates not to, conduct or agree to conduct, outside of the Collaboration, on its own or together with one or more Third Parties, the Research, Development or Commercialization of any product that contains a SHP2 Inhibitor
